verdict.rationale: A SaaS search API could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, for example in its dashboard or playground, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server and the LLM-optimized markdown output let external agents use SerpApi, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
